title: 木 tree (木字旁)
intro: 木 means tree or wood. On the left it narrows, and its last stroke becomes a dot instead of a sweep (树, 杯). At the bottom it keeps its full width (桌, 果). Characters with 木 are trees, wooden objects like tables and chairs, and words built from them.

ex.en: In the end he still didn't come.

ex.en: Eating more fruit is good for you.

ex.zh: 如果你有时间，我们一起去吧。

texts.title: 读一读 · 木 tree (木字旁)

lines.zh: 我们的学校不大，可是很漂亮。
lines.p: wǒ men de xué xiào bù dà kě shì hěn piào liang

lines.zh: 学校前面有很多树，后面有一片小森林。
lines.p: xué xiào qián miàn yǒu hěn duō shù hòu mian yǒu yī piàn xiǎo sēn lín

lines.zh: 我们的教室在三楼，里面有三十张桌子和三十把椅子。
lines.p: wǒ men de jiào shì zài sān lóu lǐ miàn yǒu sān shí zhāng zhuō zi hé sān shí bǎ yǐ zi

lines.zh: 老师每天在黑板上写很多字。
lines.p: lǎo shī měi tiān zài hēi bǎn shàng xiě hěn duō zì

lines.zh: 下课以后，我喜欢在树下喝一杯茶，看一本书。
lines.p: xià kè yǐ hòu wǒ xǐ huan zài shù xià hē yī bēi chá kàn yī běn shū

qs.q: 下课以后“我”喜欢做什么？

exercises.why: 几 is only the sound part
饭 has 饣; board has 木
交 is only the sound part
数 (number) shares 娄 but has 攵
